subtasks.description: Test with slow networks, large datasets, poor connectivity, and app backgrounding/foregrounding. Verify loading indicators, performance, and memory usage.

subtasks.title: Create QA test report with findings
subtasks.description: Document all QA findings in structured report: passed scenarios, failed scenarios, bugs found with severity, and recommendations for fixes.

subtasks.title: Fix critical QA issues and retest
subtasks.description: Address any critical or high-priority issues found during QA. Implement fixes, retest affected areas, and update QA report with retest results.
verification_steps: QA report updated with final status

phases.name: Phase 7

phases.description: Verify that Discovery page changes haven't broken other parts of the application. Test critical flows outside Discovery page and verify integration points.

subtasks.title: Identify integration points and dependencies
subtasks.description: Map all integration points between Discovery page and other app features: navigation, shared services, global state, analytics, authentication, etc.

subtasks.title: Test navigation to/from Discovery page
subtasks.description: Test all navigation paths: entry points to Discovery (deep links, tabs, buttons), navigation away from Discovery, back button behavior, and state preservation.

subtasks.title: Test shared services and global state
subtasks.description: Verify shared services (auth, notifications, analytics, caching) work correctly with Discovery changes. Test global state management and side effects.

subtasks.title: Run smoke tests on other critical features
subtasks.description: Execute smoke test suite on main app features: login, home, profile, messaging, settings. Verify no regressions in core functionality.
verification_steps: Smoke tests passed for all critical features

subtasks.title: Verify app build and deployment process
subtasks.description: Test full build process: clean build, release build, asset bundling. Verify no build errors, warnings, or configuration issues introduced.

subtasks.title: Run full automated test suite
subtasks.description: Execute complete test suite across entire codebase (not just Discovery). Verify all tests pass and no regressions in test suite.

subtasks.title: Create regression test report
subtasks.description: Document regression testing results: areas tested, issues found, risk assessment, and sign-off recommendation for production deployment.

phases.name: Phase 8

phases.description: Create comprehensive pull request with detailed description, traceability to requirements, test evidence, and QA sign-off. Update project documentation and create deployment guide.

subtasks.title: Prepare comprehensive PR description
subtasks.description: Write detailed PR description including: summary of changes, requirements addressed, implementation approach, testing performed, breaking changes, and deployment notes.

subtasks.title: Create requirements traceability matrix for PR
subtasks.description: Document which commits/files address which requirements from Phase 1. Create matrix showing requirement -> implementation -> test coverage mapping.

subtasks.title: Attach test evidence and QA reports
subtasks.description: Attach all testing artifacts to PR: coverage reports, QA test results, regression test results, screenshots, and any performance benchmarks.

subtasks.title: Update project documentation
subtasks.description: Update relevant docs: feature documentation, API docs, architecture diagrams, user guides. Ensure documentation reflects new implementation.

subtasks.title: Create deployment guide
subtasks.description: Document deployment process: prerequisites, migration steps, configuration changes, feature flags, rollback procedure, and monitoring checklist.

subtasks.title: Update CHANGELOG.md
subtasks.description: Add entry to CHANGELOG.md following project conventions. Include version, date, added/changed/fixed/removed sections, and links to requirements.

subtasks.title: Request code review and address feedback
subtasks.description: Create PR, request reviews from team members, address review comments, and iterate until approval. Ensure all CI checks pass.
verification_steps: PR created and linked to issues

subtasks.title: Merge PR to master
subtasks.description: After approval, merge PR using appropriate strategy (squash/merge). Verify merge successful, monitor CI/CD pipeline, and verify deployment to staging.

phases.name: Phase 9

phases.description: Monitor production deployment for 48-72 hours. Track error rates, performance metrics, user feedback, and critical flows. Be prepared for immediate rollback if issues detected.

subtasks.title: Set up monitoring dashboards
subtasks.description: Configure monitoring for Discovery page: error tracking, performance metrics, user analytics, API success rates. Set up alerts for anomalies.

subtasks.title: Monitor error rates and crashes (Day 1)
subtasks.description: Track error rates, crash reports, and exception logs for first 24 hours. Compare against baseline. Investigate any spikes or new error patterns.

subtasks.title: Monitor performance metrics (Day 1-2)
subtasks.description: Track page load times, API response times, memory usage, CPU usage. Compare against benchmarks. Identify any performance degradation.

subtasks.title: Monitor user behavior and analytics (Day 1-3)
subtasks.description: Track user engagement, feature usage, funnel completion rates, and user feedback. Identify any unexpected behavior changes or usability issues.

subtasks.title: Review user feedback and support tickets
subtasks.description: Monitor support channels, app reviews, and user feedback for issues related to Discovery page. Categorize and prioritize any reported problems.

subtasks.title: Execute smoke tests in production
subtasks.description: Perform manual smoke tests on production: verify critical flows working, test on multiple devices, verify data accuracy, test error scenarios.

subtasks.title: Prepare rollback plan and test rollback capability
subtasks.description: Document rollback procedure, verify rollback mechanism works, identify rollback triggers. Be ready for immediate rollback if critical issues found.

subtasks.title: Create post-deployment report and project closure
subtasks.description: After 72 hours, create final report: deployment summary, metrics summary, issues found and resolved, lessons learned, and project sign-off.

phases.name: Phase 10

verification_strategy.description: High-risk strategy due to comprehensive changes affecting critical user-facing feature. Multi-layered verification with automated testing, manual QA, regression testing, and production monitoring.

regression_testing.scope: Full app smoke tests and integration point verification

Automated test coverage ≥80% with 100% critical path coverage
All manual QA scenarios passed without critical issues
Internationalization tested in 3+ locales including RTL

Code review approved by minimum 2 reviewers

Production monitoring successful for 72 hours post-deployment

Gap analysis for different requirement categories can be parallelized after mapping

Accessibility and internationalization can be implemented concurrently

Different QA scenarios can be tested simultaneously by different team members

Phase 8 dedicated to regression testing with full app smoke tests
